Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Exact PvP cues, Smart Tab, reliable held helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with exact native-nameplate cues, LB notifications, pressure and CC awareness, PvP range rings, a Wolves' Den CC rotation panel, a bounded Purify-first held scheduler, Smart Tab, Emergency Teleport, assist macros, local MP sounds, job tools, and target highlights.
Changelog: Auto Shadowbringer now shares a fixed 1.8-second cadence across Dark Arts and the HP-cost fallback. Continuous safe HP/pressure opens one later fallback generation; Dark Arts still wins and ignores those sliders. Preserve Blackblood remains on by default, blocks both paths while exact status 3033 is present, and no longer deadlocks when a confirmed or ambiguous request's complete short status lifecycle falls between samples; ambiguous calls still require the frozen key to be released. Exact CC uses frozen held Smart Action targeting without a visible target change. Wolves' Den uses only exact <t> duel/dummy targeting and test-only zero pressure while retaining HP, range, line-of-sight, cadence, and Blackblood gates. The expanded rotation panel shows seven local FFXIV duty-artwork cards with a 0.65-second reorder animation and no network request. Configuration schema 43 is current; live current-patch action and visual validation remains separate.
